subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class per-user token and cost accounting for multi-user billing/quota workflows, and if so should that ledger be core-owned or plugin-owned?
rationale: The feature crosses product scope, privacy/security policy, storage design, channel identity mapping, and Dashboard/API surface area, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design a core accounting surface
options.body: Define a privacy-reviewed SQLite usage ledger plus authorized Dashboard/API views before implementation.

options.title: Add plugin hooks first
options.body: Keep core lean and expose only the stable runtime events/API needed for an external billing or accounting plugin.

options.title: Decline multi-user accounting
options.body: Document that OpenClaw provides session/provider usage summaries but not user-level billing reports.

recommendation.title: Design a core accounting surface
recommendation.body: Define a privacy-reviewed SQLite usage ledger plus authorized Dashboard/API views before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider usage and billing work makes this the closest product and implementation ownership signal.
